# bamboo_lid_box — realism QA repair

Rounded rectangular glass cavity; thin blue-green rim; bamboo lift-off lid. Contents missing.

## Evidence and numerical review

Three original calibrated frames: f2164, f1842, f2001. Mean silhouette IoU 0.8845. Photo contours are hand traced, with approximately 2–4 px uncertainty at 256 px crop resolution. Explicit masks exclude selected occluders. Wire masks additionally use a dark-pixel threshold. This is not certified segmentation ground truth.

Comparison: [photo / render / overlay](../review/bamboo_lid_box_compare.jpg). Full calibration, masks and measurements: `../review/bamboo_lid_box/`.

Grades: evidence=B, silhouette=B, proportions=B, colour_texture=C, articulation=B, physics=C, collision=B, instances=B

## Changes

- Added three original calibrated photo crops, traced photo masks and numerical comparisons.
- Added explicit mass basis/uncertainty, constituent density, material-specific friction, restitution, COM prior and fragility.
- Refined size and world registration using two views and third-view check.
- Replaced blurred bamboo patch with source-guided generated grain.
- Glass remains hollow with finite wall thickness; bamboo lid is a separate lift-off part.

## Remaining

- Visible internal packets are still absent; their count and poses are unresolved.
- Glass refraction is not validated against the complete surrounding kitchen.
- Real present mass, friction, restitution and stiffness have not been measured; physics values are explicit priors.
